definition: Kyoung Mu Lee (Korean: 이경무) is a South Korean computer scientist and professor at Seoul National University (SNU).
details: His research specializes in computer vision, specifically image restoration, 3D human pose estimation, and visual tracking. Since 2021, he has served as the Editor-in-Chief of the IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). According to Google Scholar, his publications have received over 50,000 citations.
